description: This file defines a PHP class 'ViewDisplaydeployresult' which extends 'SugarView' and is responsible for rendering a specific view related to deployment results within the SuiteCRM module. It mostly manages presentation logic, disables UI components, and outputs a message along with a JavaScript request to rebuild relationships asynchronously.

classes.name: ViewDisplaydeployresult
classes.description: A PHP class responsible for displaying deployment result messages in the SuiteCRM admin interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the view, configuring UI component visibility settings.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module title, including localized labels and module-specific titles.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs a message and triggers an asynchronous JavaScript request to rebuild relationships.
